items.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Nesuhi Ertegun heard me on those recordings and signed me to Atlantic Records.

ctx.x: the—thousands of recordings, may I say?

Yes, since then. (Laughs) I’ve made over 150 records with people or on assignment. I did like three albums with Eric Kloss on the Prestige label. Then I got, from my recording with Herbie Mann, Nesuhi Ertegun heard me on those recordings and signed me to Atlantic Records.
